question: James Fishback vote share in 2026 Florida Republican Governor Primary?
resolution_criteria:
Primary elections in Florida are scheduled to be held on August 18, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the share of valid votes James Fishback wins in the 2026 Florida Republican Gubernatorial Primary.

If the reported value falls exactly between two brackets, then this market will resolve to the higher range bracket.

If the results of the specified election are not known definitively by November 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to the lowest bracket.

The primary resolution source for this market will be information from the State of Florida, such as official statewide results published by the Florida Department of State (https://dos.fl.gov/); however, an overwhelming consensus of credible reporting may suffice.

If a recount is initiated before the vote total has been made official, the market will remain open until the recount is completed and the vote is made official.
research:
I could not find any official result or other fact dated on or before 2026-07-28 that settles this question. Polls taken in July put Fishback between 4% and 12%, and on 2026-07-22 Kalshi priced "below 10%" at 71%. My searches did turn up some reporting dated after the cutoff, and I left all of it out as instructed.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on official statewide results from the Florida Department of State ([dos.fl.gov](https://dos.fl.gov/)), and the primary is on 2026-08-18. Results could not exist yet as of 2026-07-28, so I did not fetch a value from that site. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Florida_elections)

## 2. Current status (as of 2026-07-28)
- Nothing has settled the outcome yet. Byron Donalds leads every poll by a wide margin. Fishback, Lt. Gov. Jay Collins and Paul Renner are fighting for a distant second place.
- 2026-07-28: Reports say Fishback won the case over his ballot eligibility, which was a challenge to whether he meets the 7-year residency requirement. That would keep him on the ballot. [prediction.com](https://prediction.com/news/fishback-s-2nd-place-odds-drop-18-points-to-20-jul-22-2026)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-07-28: Fishback reportedly won the residency and ballot case. [prediction.com](https://prediction.com/news/fishback-hits-27-for-florida-gop-governor-2nd-jul-26-2026)
- 2026-07-26: Tyson Group poll: Donalds 48%, Collins 9%, Fishback 8%, Renner 4%, about 26% undecided. Donalds had reportedly raised about $90M. Fishback was dropped from a debate after the Republican Party of Florida withdrew his invitation to the "Sunshine State Showdown." [prediction.com](https://prediction.com/news/fishback-hits-27-for-florida-gop-governor-2nd-jul-26-2026)
- About 2026-07-20 to 26: James Madison Institute poll (fielded July 20-26): Donalds 49%, Collins 18%, Renner 8%, Fishback 4%. I could not confirm whether it was published before 2026-07-28. [Newsweek](https://www.newsweek.com/byron-donalds-chances-winning-florida-gop-primary-final-primary-polls-12331829)
- 2026-07-20: Cygnal released its July 12-13 poll of 500 likely GOP primary voters (margin of error ±4.38): Donalds 43%, Fishback 12%, Collins 11%, Renner 2%, 31% undecided. Fishback's support is concentrated among young men and low-propensity voters. In this poll his share falls among people who vote in every primary, while Donalds rises from 27% to 48% across that same scale. [Cygnal](https://www.cygn.al/news/poll-donalds-leads-florida-gop-governor-primary-with-a-third-of-voters-still-undecided/), [PDF](https://www.cygn.al/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/FL-Gov-Statewide-GOP-Primary.pdf)
- 2026-07-11: The Front Line, a nonprofit aligned with Ted Cruz, launched a $400K ad campaign attacking Fishback over remarks it calls antisemitic. [prediction.com](https://prediction.com/news/fishback-s-2nd-place-odds-drop-18-points-to-20-jul-22-2026)
- July 9-11: Change Research poll of registered voters: Donalds 37%, Collins 14%, Fishback 12%, Renner 2%. [Newsweek](https://www.newsweek.com/byron-donalds-chances-winning-florida-gop-primary-final-primary-polls-12331829)
- 2026-06-30: Collins filed the residency challenge against Fishback. [prediction.com](https://prediction.com/news/fishback-s-2nd-place-odds-drop-18-points-to-20-jul-22-2026)
- June 3-7: Associated Industries of Florida (AIF) poll, n=386: Donalds 54%, Fishback 8%, Collins 5%, Renner 2%, 31% undecided. Decision Desk HQ (DDHQ) notes that an earlier TPSI poll was secretly sponsored by Fishback's campaign. [DDHQ](https://decisiondeskhq.substack.com/p/florida-primary-election-2026-donalds-fishback-trump-desantis-redistricting-dsa-moskowitz-larkin)

## 4. Base rates and polling trend
- Fishback's July range is 4% to 12%: JMI 4, Tyson 8, Cygnal 12, Change 12. In June, AIF had him at 8%. One five-poll average put him at about 12.1%. [search summary / RCP](https://www.realclearpolling.com/polls/governor/republican-primary/2026/florida)
- The undecided share is large, 26% to 31%. If undecideds split in proportion to current support, Fishback's 8-12% in polls would become roughly 11-17% of the actual vote. Cygnal's turnout breakdown, though, suggests high-propensity primary voters lean against him.
- The trend runs against him. His party support was withdrawn (forum invitation pulled), outside groups are running attack ads, and Collins has been rising in the JMI poll.
- I found no systematic base rate for how insurgent third candidates perform against their polling in Florida GOP primaries.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-07-22: Kalshi's vote-share market priced Fishback finishing under 10% at 71%. [prediction.com](https://prediction.com/news/fishback-s-2nd-place-odds-drop-18-points-to-20-jul-22-2026), [Kalshi](https://kalshi.com/markets/kxvoteprimary/vote-percentages-in-primaries/kxvoteprimary-govflnomr26jfis)
- Early July: Polymarket's vote-share market (this question) had 10-15% at about 39% and under 10% at about 34%. I could not confirm the exact date of that snapshot. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/james-fishback-vote-share-in-2026-florida-republican-governor-primary-20260701214154078)
- Odds of Fishback finishing second: 38% (about July 19), 20-21% (July 22), 27% (July 26; Kalshi 32%, Polymarket 22%). On July 28, Collins was at 44% for second place. [prediction.com](https://prediction.com/news/fishback-hits-27-for-florida-gop-governor-2nd-jul-26-2026)
- Donalds is priced at about 99% to win the nomination. [DefiRate](https://defirate.com/prediction-markets/primaries/florida-republican-governor-nominee-2026/)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Any appeal of the residency ruling, which could raise the risk of him being removed from the ballot.
- More polls, including the Quantus final read, which is due after the cutoff.
- Ad spending by outside groups, debates and forums, and possible endorsements from Trump or DeSantis.
- Mail and early voting turnout, since Fishback depends on low-propensity voters.
- Primary day, 2026-08-18. After that, county canvass, any recount, and state certification.
